_note: Source of truth for every later phase. x/z are metres from the origin: +x east, +z south, +y up. Regenerate with `node scripts/fetch-phase1-geo.js`.

origin.label: Shore Temple
origin.method: vertex mean of the OSM way
origin.whyChanged: The brief's longitude is ~80 m west of the OSM way, the Google Maps place record and this repo's sites.geojson (TM-018), which all agree with each other. On the brief's origin the Shore Temple lands ~157 m from the coastline and fails the brief's own <100 m check; on this one it is 76.8 m.

projection.note: Equirectangular about the origin. Good to a few cm over a 3 km scene; do not reuse at country scale.

crossReference.note: Add these to an anchors.json x/z to get scene coordinates.

anchors.label: Shore Temple
anchors.orientationSource: East-facing onto the Bay of Bengal — stated in this repo's own guide copy (mahabalipuram.html) and general to the monument's description.

anchors.label: Pancha Rathas (compound)
